description: The live signal of a device, from its engine, as its face shows it: what goes in and comes out (levels, activity, a scope, a spectrum, a history, the stereo samples) and what the device declares in signals (its gain reduction, its modulator and wet taps). Analysers go on a point only while something watches it, one frame loop reads every signal on the page, and a signal follows the engine a host makes again.
name: device-signal
